{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///c%3A/VSCODE_Developement/logicappsdevelopment/logicappsdevelopment/mcp-dataverse-server/scripts/get_case_metadata.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///c%3A/VSCODE_Developement/logicappsdevelopment/logicappsdevelopment/mcp-dataverse-server/scripts/get_case_metadata.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python\n\"\"\"\nRetrieve Case metadata from Dynamics 365 Customer Service:\n- Subjects (from subjects entity)\n- Case Origins (caseorigincode option set on incident)\n- Priorities (prioritycode option set on incident)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\n# Add the parent src to the path\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\", \"src\"))\n\nfrom mcp_dataverse_server.settings import get_settings\nfrom mcp_dataverse_server.dataverse import DataverseClient\n\n\ndef get_option_set_values(client: DataverseClient, entity_name: str, attribute_name: str) -&gt; list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Retrieve option set values for a given entity attribute.\n    \n    Uses the EntityDefinitions API to get picklist metadata.\n    \"\"\"\n    url = (\n        f\"EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='{entity_name}')\"\n        f\"/Attributes(LogicalName='{attribute_name}')\"\n        f\"/Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM.PicklistAttributeMetadata\"\n        f\"?$select=LogicalName&amp;$expand=OptionSet($select=Options)\"\n    )\n    \n    with client._client() as http:\n        resp = http.get(client._url(url), headers=client._headers())\n        resp.raise_for_status()\n        data = resp.json()\n    \n    options = data.get(\"OptionSet\", {}).get(\"Options\", [])\n    return [\n        {\n            \"value\": opt.get(\"Value\"),\n            \"label\": opt.get(\"Label\", {}).get(\"UserLocalizedLabel\", {}).get(\"Label\", \"Unknown\"),\n        }\n        for opt in options\n    ]\n\n\ndef get_subjects(client: DataverseClient) -&gt; list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"Retrieve all subjects from the subjects entity.\"\"\"\n    url = client._url(\n        \"subjects\"\n        \"?$select=subjectid,title,description,_parentsubject_value\"\n        \"&amp;$orderby=title\"\n    )\n    \n    with client._client() as http:\n        resp = http.get(url, headers=client._headers())\n        resp.raise_for_status()\n        data = resp.json()\n    \n    return [\n        {\n            \"id\": s.get(\"subjectid\"),\n            \"title\": s.get(\"title\"),\n            \"description\": s.get(\"description\"),\n            \"parent_id\": s.get(\"_parentsubject_value\"),\n        }\n        for s in data.get(\"value\", [])\n    ]\n\n\ndef main():\n    settings = get_settings()\n    client = DataverseClient(settings)\n    \n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"DYNAMICS 365 CUSTOMER SERVICE - CASE METADATA\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    # 1. Get Subjects\n    print(\"\\n📋 SUBJECTS\")\n    print(\"-\" * 40)\n    try:\n        subjects = get_subjects(client)\n        if subjects:\n            for s in subjects:\n                parent_info = f\" (Parent: {s['parent_id'][:8]}...)\" if s.get(\"parent_id\") else \"\"\n                print(f\"  • {s['title']}{parent_info}\")\n                if s.get(\"description\"):\n                    print(f\"    └─ {s['description'][:60]}...\")\n            print(f\"\\n  Total: {len(subjects)} subjects\")\n        else:\n            print(\"  No subjects found.\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Error fetching subjects: {e}\")\n    \n    # 2. Get Case Origins (caseorigincode)\n    print(\"\\n📍 CASE ORIGINS (caseorigincode)\")\n    print(\"-\" * 40)\n    try:\n        origins = get_option_set_values(client, \"incident\", \"caseorigincode\")\n        if origins:\n            for opt in sorted(origins, key=lambda x: x[\"value\"]):\n                print(f\"  {opt['value']:3d} = {opt['label']}\")\n            print(f\"\\n  Total: {len(origins)} origins\")\n        else:\n            print(\"  No case origins found.\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Error fetching case origins: {e}\")\n    \n    # 3. Get Priorities (prioritycode)\n    print(\"\\n⚡ PRIORITIES (prioritycode)\")\n    print(\"-\" * 40)\n    try:\n        priorities = get_option_set_values(client, \"incident\", \"prioritycode\")\n        if priorities:\n            for opt in sorted(priorities, key=lambda x: x[\"value\"]):\n                print(f\"  {opt['value']:3d} = {opt['label']}\")\n            print(f\"\\n  Total: {len(priorities)} priorities\")\n        else:\n            print(\"  No priorities found.\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Error fetching priorities: {e}\")\n    \n    # Bonus: Also get status codes\n    print(\"\\n🔄 STATUS CODES (statuscode)\")\n    print(\"-\" * 40)\n    try:\n        statuses = get_option_set_values(client, \"incident\", \"statuscode\")\n        if statuses:\n            for opt in sorted(statuses, key=lambda x: x[\"value\"]):\n                print(f\"  {opt['value']:3d} = {opt['label']}\")\n            print(f\"\\n  Total: {len(statuses)} statuses\")\n        else:\n            print(\"  No statuses found.\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Error fetching statuses: {e}\")\n    \n    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"Done!\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python\n\"\"\"\nRetrieve Case metadata from Dynamics 365 Customer Service:\n- Subjects (from subjects entity)\n- Case Origins (caseorigincode option set on incident)\n- Priorities (prioritycode option set on incident)\n\nUsage:\n    python -m powerplatform.get_case_metadata\n    or\n    python src/powerplatform/get_case_metadata.py\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nimport os\n\n# Ensure the src directory is in the path\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\", \"..\"))\n\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom rich.console import Console\nfrom rich.table import Table\n\nfrom powerplatform.client import DataverseClient\n\n\nconsole = Console()\n\n\ndef get_option_set_values(client: DataverseClient, entity_name: str, attribute_name: str) -&gt; list[dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Retrieve option set (picklist) values for a given entity attribute.\n    \n    Uses the Dataverse Web API EntityDefinitions to get picklist metadata.\n    \n    Args:\n        client: DataverseClient instance\n        entity_name: Logical name of the entity (e.g., 'incident')\n        attribute_name: Logical name of the attribute (e.g., 'caseorigincode')\n    \n    Returns:\n        List of dicts with 'value' and 'label' keys\n    \"\"\"\n    endpoint = (\n        f\"EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='{entity_name}')\"\n        f\"/Attributes(LogicalName='{attribute_name}')\"\n        f\"/Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM.PicklistAttributeMetadata\"\n        f\"?$select=LogicalName&amp;$expand=OptionSet($select=Options)\"\n    )\n    \n    data = client._request(\"GET\", endpoint)\n    \n    options = data.get(\"OptionSet\", {}).get(\"Options\", [])\n    return [\n        {\n            \"value\": opt.get(\"Value\"),\n            \"label\": opt.get(\"Label\", {}).get(\"UserLocalizedLabel\", {}).get(\"Label\", \"Unknown\"),\n        }\n        for opt in options\n    ]\n\n\ndef display_option_set(title: str, options: list[dict[str, Any]], icon: str = \"📋\") -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"Display option set values in a formatted table.\"\"\"\n    table = Table(title=f\"{icon} {title}\")\n    table.add_column(\"Value\", style=\"cyan\", justify=\"right\")\n    table.add_column(\"Label\", style=\"white\")\n    \n    for opt in sorted(options, key=lambda x: x[\"value\"]):\n        table.add_row(str(opt[\"value\"]), opt[\"label\"])\n    \n    console.print(table)\n    console.print(f\"[dim]Total: {len(options)} options[/dim]\\n\")\n\n\ndef display_subjects(client: DataverseClient) -&gt; None:\n    \"\"\"Display subjects in a hierarchical table.\"\"\"\n    subjects = client.get_subjects()\n    \n    table = Table(title=\"📂 Subjects\")\n    table.add_column(\"ID\", style=\"dim\", max_width=36)\n    table.add_column(\"Title\", style=\"cyan\")\n    table.add_column(\"Description\", style=\"white\", max_width=50)\n    table.add_column(\"Parent\", style=\"dim\")\n    \n    for subject in subjects:\n        parent = \"Yes\" if subject.parent_id else \"-\"\n        desc = subject.description[:47] + \"...\" if subject.description and len(subject.description) &gt; 50 else (subject.description or \"-\")\n        table.add_row(\n            subject.id[:8] + \"...\",\n            subject.title,\n            desc,\n            parent,\n        )\n    \n    console.print(table)\n    console.print(f\"[dim]Total: {len(subjects)} subjects[/dim]\\n\")\n\n\ndef main():\n    console.print(\"\\n[bold cyan]═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════[/]\")\n    console.print(\"[bold]       DYNAMICS 365 CUSTOMER SERVICE - CASE METADATA[/]\")\n    console.print(\"[bold cyan]═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════[/]\\n\")\n    \n    try:\n        with DataverseClient() as client:\n            # 1. Get Subjects\n            console.print(\"[bold green]1. SUBJECTS[/] (from 'subjects' entity)\\n\")\n            try:\n                display_subjects(client)\n            except Exception as e:\n                console.print(f\"[red]Error fetching subjects: {e}[/]\\n\")\n            \n            # 2. Get Case Origins (caseorigincode)\n            console.print(\"[bold green]2. CASE ORIGINS[/] (from 'incident.caseorigincode' option set)\\n\")\n            try:\n                origins = get_option_set_values(client, \"incident\", \"caseorigincode\")\n                display_option_set(\"Case Origins\", origins, \"📍\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                console.print(f\"[red]Error fetching case origins: {e}[/]\\n\")\n            \n            # 3. Get Priorities (prioritycode)\n            console.print(\"[bold green]3. PRIORITIES[/] (from 'incident.prioritycode' option set)\\n\")\n            try:\n                priorities = get_option_set_values(client, \"incident\", \"prioritycode\")\n                display_option_set(\"Priorities\", priorities, \"⚡\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                console.print(f\"[red]Error fetching priorities: {e}[/]\\n\")\n            \n            # Bonus: Status codes\n            console.print(\"[bold green]4. STATUS CODES[/] (from 'incident.statuscode' option set)\\n\")\n            try:\n                statuses = get_option_set_values(client, \"incident\", \"statuscode\")\n                display_option_set(\"Status Codes\", statuses, \"🔄\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                console.print(f\"[red]Error fetching statuses: {e}[/]\\n\")\n    \n    except Exception as e:\n        console.print(f\"[bold red]Failed to connect to Dataverse:[/] {e}\")\n        console.print(\"\\n[yellow]Make sure you have the following environment variables set:[/]\")\n        console.print(\"  • DATAVERSE_BASE_URL\")\n        console.print(\"  • DATAVERSE_TENANT_ID\")\n        console.print(\"  • DATAVERSE_CLIENT_ID\")\n        console.print(\"  • DATAVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n    \n    console.print(\"[bold cyan]═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════[/]\")\n    console.print(\"[green]✓ Done![/]\\n\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python\n\"\"\"\nGet the conversation transcript from a known conversation ID.\n\nThe conversation was found on the case timeline via activitypointers.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nimport os\nimport json\nimport base64\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\", \"src\"))\n\nfrom powerplatform.client import DataverseClient\n\n# The conversation ID found on the case timeline\nCONVERSATION_ID = \"b6745d2f-2b3e-4344-8a8e-457d542e8dfa\"\nCASE_ID = \"7811eee8-60fb-f011-8406-7ced8d4279eb\"\n\n\ndef main():\n    with DataverseClient() as client:\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        print(\"CONVERSATION TRANSCRIPT RETRIEVAL\")\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        print(f\"Case ID: {CASE_ID}\")\n        print(f\"Conversation ID: {CONVERSATION_ID}\")\n        \n        # Step 1: Get conversation details\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"-\" * 80)\n        print(\"STEP 1: Get Conversation Details\")\n        print(\"-\" * 80)\n        \n        try:\n            conv = client._request(\"GET\", f\"msdyn_ocliveworkitems({CONVERSATION_ID})\")\n            print(f\"Title: {conv.get('msdyn_title', 'N/A')}\")\n            print(f\"Created: {conv.get('createdon')}\")\n            print(f\"Customer: {conv.get('_msdyn_customer_value@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue', conv.get('_msdyn_customer_value'))}\")\n            print(f\"Channel: {conv.get('msdyn_channel@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue', conv.get('msdyn_channel'))}\")\n            print(f\"Status: {conv.get('statuscode@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue', conv.get('statuscode'))}\")\n            print(f\"Work Stream: {conv.get('_msdyn_liveworkstreamid_value@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue', 'N/A')}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error getting conversation details: {e}\")\n        \n        transcript_found = False\n        \n        # Step 2: Try msdyn_transcripts entity\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"-\" * 80)\n        print(\"STEP 2: Look for Transcript in msdyn_transcripts\")\n        print(\"-\" * 80)\n        \n        try:\n            path = f\"msdyn_transcripts?$filter=_msdyn_liveworkitemid_value eq {CONVERSATION_ID}&amp;$orderby=createdon desc\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            \n            if result.get(\"value\"):\n                print(f\"Found {len(result['value'])} transcript record(s)\")\n                for t in result[\"value\"]:\n                    print(f\"\\nTranscript ID: {t.get('msdyn_transcriptid')}\")\n                    print(f\"Created: {t.get('createdon')}\")\n                    \n                    # Check all possible content fields\n                    content = t.get(\"msdyn_transcriptcontrol\") or t.get(\"msdyn_output\") or t.get(\"msdyn_transcriptoutput\")\n                    if content:\n                        transcript_found = True\n                        print(\"\\nTranscript Content:\")\n                        print(\"=\" * 60)\n                        try:\n                            parsed = json.loads(content)\n                            print(json.dumps(parsed, indent=2))\n                        except:\n                            print(content)\n            else:\n                print(\"No transcripts found in msdyn_transcripts entity\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error: {e}\")\n        \n        # Step 3: Try annotations (transcript stored as attachment)\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"-\" * 80)\n        print(\"STEP 3: Look for Transcript in Annotations (Notes)\")\n        print(\"-\" * 80)\n        \n        try:\n            path = f\"annotations?$filter=_objectid_value eq {CONVERSATION_ID}&amp;$select=annotationid,subject,notetext,filename,documentbody,mimetype,createdon&amp;$orderby=createdon desc\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            \n            if result.get(\"value\"):\n                print(f\"Found {len(result['value'])} annotation(s)\")\n                for note in result[\"value\"]:\n                    print(f\"\\nAnnotation ID: {note.get('annotationid')}\")\n                    print(f\"Subject: {note.get('subject')}\")\n                    print(f\"Filename: {note.get('filename')}\")\n                    print(f\"MIME Type: {note.get('mimetype')}\")\n                    print(f\"Created: {note.get('createdon')}\")\n                    \n                    # Decode document body if present\n                    doc_body = note.get(\"documentbody\")\n                    if doc_body:\n                        transcript_found = True\n                        print(\"\\nDecoded Transcript Content:\")\n                        print(\"=\" * 60)\n                        try:\n                            decoded = base64.b64decode(doc_body).decode(\"utf-8\")\n                            try:\n                                # Parse and pretty-print JSON\n                                parsed = json.loads(decoded)\n                                \n                                # Format the transcript nicely\n                                if isinstance(parsed, list):\n                                    for item in parsed:\n                                        sender = item.get(\"from\", {}).get(\"user\", {}).get(\"displayName\", \"Unknown\")\n                                        content = item.get(\"content\", \"\")\n                                        timestamp = item.get(\"createdDateTime\", \"\")\n                                        \n                                        # Handle HTML content\n                                        if \"&lt;p&gt;\" in content:\n                                            import re\n                                            content = re.sub(r'&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '', content)\n                                        \n                                        print(f\"\\n[{timestamp[:19]}] {sender}:\")\n                                        print(f\"  {content}\")\n                                else:\n                                    print(json.dumps(parsed, indent=2))\n                            except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                                print(decoded[:5000])\n                        except Exception as e:\n                            print(f\"Error decoding: {e}\")\n                    \n                    # Also show notetext if present\n                    notetext = note.get(\"notetext\")\n                    if notetext:\n                        print(f\"\\nNote Text: {notetext[:500]}\")\n            else:\n                print(\"No annotations found\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error: {e}\")\n        \n        # Step 4: Try conversation action messages\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"-\" * 80)\n        print(\"STEP 4: Look for Conversation Action/Messages\")\n        print(\"-\" * 80)\n        \n        try:\n            path = f\"msdyn_ocliveworkitemconversationactions?$filter=_msdyn_ocliveworkitemid_value eq {CONVERSATION_ID}&amp;$orderby=createdon asc\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            \n            if result.get(\"value\"):\n                print(f\"Found {len(result['value'])} conversation actions\")\n                for action in result[\"value\"]:\n                    print(f\"  - {action.get('createdon')}: {action.get('msdyn_name', 'N/A')}\")\n            else:\n                print(\"No conversation actions found\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Entity not found or error: {e}\")\n        \n        # Step 5: Check msdyn_ocsession for session-based transcripts\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"-\" * 80)\n        print(\"STEP 5: Look for Session Data\")\n        print(\"-\" * 80)\n        \n        try:\n            path = f\"msdyn_ocsessions?$filter=_msdyn_liveworkitemid_value eq {CONVERSATION_ID}&amp;$orderby=createdon desc\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            \n            if result.get(\"value\"):\n                print(f\"Found {len(result['value'])} session(s)\")\n                for session in result[\"value\"]:\n                    session_id = session.get(\"msdyn_ocsessionid\")\n                    print(f\"\\n  Session ID: {session_id}\")\n                    print(f\"  Created: {session.get('createdon')}\")\n                    print(f\"  Agent: {session.get('_msdyn_agentid_value@OData.Community.Display.V1.FormattedValue', session.get('_msdyn_agentid_value'))}\")\n                    \n                    # Try to get transcript for this session\n                    try:\n                        ann_path = f\"annotations?$filter=_objectid_value eq {session_id}&amp;$select=subject,filename,documentbody\"\n                        ann_result = client._request(\"GET\", ann_path)\n                        if ann_result.get(\"value\"):\n                            print(f\"  Found {len(ann_result['value'])} annotation(s) on session\")\n                    except:\n                        pass\n            else:\n                print(\"No sessions found\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error: {e}\")\n        \n        # Summary\n        print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 80)\n        print(\"SUMMARY\")\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        print(f\"Transcript Found: {'Yes' if transcript_found else 'No - try checking the conversation directly in D365'}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python\n\"\"\"\nGet the conversation transcript - final attempt with correct OData syntax.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nimport os\nimport json\nimport base64\nimport re\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\", \"src\"))\n\nfrom powerplatform.client import DataverseClient\n\nCONVERSATION_ID = \"b6745d2f-2b3e-4344-8a8e-457d542e8dfa\"\n\n\ndef main():\n    with DataverseClient() as client:\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        print(\"TRANSCRIPT RETRIEVAL FOR CONVERSATION\")\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        print(f\"Conversation ID: {CONVERSATION_ID}\")\n        \n        # Get all transcripts and find matching one\n        print(\"\\n1. Checking session annotations...\")\n        print(\"-\" * 60)\n        \n        try:\n            # First get sessions\n            path = f\"msdyn_ocsessions?$select=msdyn_ocsessionid,msdyn_name,createdon&amp;$top=100\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            sessions = result.get(\"value\", [])\n            \n            # For each session, check if it's linked to our conversation\n            for session in sessions:\n                session_id = session.get(\"msdyn_ocsessionid\")\n                if not session_id:\n                    continue\n                \n                #   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python\n\"\"\"\nFind the transcript in annotations - search by conversation ID and related objects.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nimport os\nimport json\nimport base64\nimport re\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\", \"src\"))\n\nfrom powerplatform.client import DataverseClient\n\nCONVERSATION_ID = \"b6745d2f-2b3e-4344-8a8e-457d542e8dfa\"\nCASE_ID = \"7811eee8-60fb-f011-8406-7ced8d4279eb\"\n\n# Related IDs from the conversation\nRELATED_IDS = [\n    CONVERSATION_ID,  # The conversation itself\n    CASE_ID,  # The case\n    \"fe39c2d8-4ea6-45a9-b1c1-e77efd80114b\",  # msdyn_lastsessionid\n    \"7fba73b9-2461-ef11-bfe2-002248a36d0e\",  # customer (contact)\n]\n\n\ndef main():\n    with DataverseClient() as client:\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        print(\"SEARCHING ANNOTATIONS FOR TRANSCRIPT\")\n        print(\"=\" * 80)\n        \n        # Get all annotations and check for transcript-related ones\n        print(\"\\n1. Getting all recent annotations and searching for transcript...\")\n        print(\"-\" * 60)\n        \n        try:\n            # Get more annotations with all fields\n            path = \"annotations?$select=annotationid,subject,filename,documentbody,notetext,_objectid_value,objecttypecode,mimetype,createdon&amp;$orderby=createdon desc&amp;$top=200\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            annotations = result.get(\"value\", [])\n            print(f\"   Retrieved {len(annotations)} annotations\")\n            \n            # Search for matching ones\n            found = False\n            for ann in annotations:\n                obj_id = str(ann.get(\"_objectid_value\", \"\")).lower()\n                subject = str(ann.get(\"subject\", \"\")).lower()\n                filename = str(ann.get(\"filename\", \"\")).lower()\n                \n                # Check if it matches any of our related IDs\n                matches_id = any(obj_id == rid.lower() for rid in RELATED_IDS if rid)\n                \n                # Or check if it contains transcript-related keywords\n                is_transcript = \"transcript\" in subject or \"transcript\" in filename\n                \n                if matches_id or is_transcript:\n                    found = True\n                    print(f\"\\n   ✓ FOUND: {ann.get('subject')}\")\n                    print(f\"     Annotation ID: {ann.get('annotationid')}\")\n                    print(f\"     Object ID: {ann.get('_objectid_value')}\")\n                    print(f\"     Object Type: {ann.get('objecttypecode')}\")\n                    print(f\"     Filename: {ann.get('filename')}\")\n                    print(f\"     MIME Type: {ann.get('mimetype')}\")\n                    print(f\"     Created: {ann.get('createdon')}\")\n                    \n                    # Decode and display content\n                    doc_body = ann.get(\"documentbody\")\n                    if doc_body:\n                        print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)\n                        print(\"TRANSCRIPT CONTENT\")\n                        print(\"=\" * 60)\n                        \n                        try:\n                            decoded = base64.b64decode(doc_body).decode(\"utf-8\")\n                            try:\n                                parsed = json.loads(decoded)\n                                \n                                # Format nicely if it's an array of messages\n                                if isinstance(parsed, list):\n                                    for msg in parsed:\n                                        if isinstance(msg, dict):\n                                            # Extract sender\n                                            from_info = msg.get(\"from\", {})\n                                            user_info = from_info.get(\"user\", {}) if isinstance(from_info, dict) else {}\n                                            sender = user_info.get(\"displayName\", from_info.get(\"displayName\", \"Unknown\"))\n                                            \n                                            # Extract content\n                                            content = msg.get(\"content\", msg.get(\"text\", \"\"))\n                                            timestamp = str(msg.get(\"createdDateTime\", msg.get(\"timestamp\", \"\")))[:19]\n                                            \n                                            # Clean HTML\n                                            content = re.sub(r'&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '', str(content)).strip()\n                                            \n                                            if content:\n                                                print(f\"\\n[{timestamp}] {sender}:\")\n                                                print(f\"  {content}\")\n                                else:\n                                    print(json.dumps(parsed, indent=2))\n                            except json.JSONDecodeError:\n                                print(decoded[:5000])\n                        except Exception as e:\n                            print(f\"   Decode error: {e}\")\n                    \n                    notetext = ann.get(\"notetext\")\n                    if notetext:\n                        print(f\"\\n   Note Text: {notetext[:500]}\")\n            \n            if not found:\n                print(\"   No matching annotations found in first 200 records\")\n                \n                # Let's also print unique object types we see\n                print(\"\\n   Unique object types seen:\")\n                types = {}\n                for ann in annotations:\n                    otype = ann.get(\"objecttypecode\")\n                    if otype:\n                        types[otype] = types.get(otype, 0) + 1\n                for t, c in sorted(types.items()):\n                    print(f\"     {t}: {c} annotations\")\n                    \n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"   Error: {e}\")\n        \n        # Also try searching by the session ID\n        print(\"\\n2. Searching annotations by session ID...\")\n        print(\"-\" * 60)\n        session_id = \"fe39c2d8-4ea6-45a9-b1c1-e77efd80114b\"\n        try:\n            path = f\"annotations?$filter=_objectid_value eq {session_id}&amp;$select=annotationid,subject,filename,documentbody\"\n            result = client._request(\"GET\", path)\n            annotations = result.get(\"value\", [])\n            print(f\"   Found {len(annotations)} annotations for session\")\n            \n            for ann in annotations:\n                print(f\"\\n   Subject: {ann.get('subject')}\")\n                print(f\"   Filename: {ann.get('filename')}\")\n                \n                doc_body = ann.get(\"documentbody\")\n                if doc_body:\n                    decoded = base64.b64decode(doc_body).decode(\"utf-8\")\n                    print(\"\\n   CONTENT:\")\n                    try:\n                        parsed = json.loads(decoded)\n                        if isinstance(parsed, list):\n                            for msg in parsed:\n                                sender = msg.get(\"from\", {}).get(\"user\", {}).get(\"displayName\", \"Unknown\")\n                                content = re.sub(r'&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '', str(msg.get(\"content\", \"\"))).strip()\n                                timestamp = str(msg.get(\"createdDateTime\", \"\"))[:19]\n                                if content:\n                                    print(f\"\\n   [{timestamp}] {sender}:\")\n                                    print(f\"     {content}\")\n                        else:\n                            print(json.dumps(parsed, indent=2)[:2000])\n                    except:\n                        print(decoded[:2000])\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"   Error: {e}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

0:\n                content_str = outer[0].get(\"Content\", \"\")\n                messages = json.loads(content_str)\n                \n                # Filter out control messages and sort by timestamp\n                user_messages = [m for m in messages if not m.get(\"isControlMessage\", False)]\n                user_messages.sort(key=lambda x: x.get(\"createdDateTime\", \"\"))\n                \n                print(f\"\\nTotal messages: {len(user_messages)} (excluding control messages)\")\n                print(\"-\" * 60)\n                \n                for msg in user_messages:\n                    from_info = msg.get(\"from\", {})\n                    user_info = from_info.get(\"user\", {})\n                    sender = user_info.get(\"displayName\", \"Copilot\")\n                    content = msg.get(\"content\", \"\")\n                    timestamp = msg.get(\"createdDateTime\", \"\")[:19]\n                    \n                    # Clean HTML tags\n                    content = re.sub(r'&lt;[^&gt;]+&gt;', '', str(content)).strip()\n                    \n                    # Skip empty messages\n                    if not content:\n                        continue\n                    \n                    # Format nicely\n                    print(f\"\\n[{timestamp}] {sender}:\")\n                    \n                    # Wrap long lines\n                    words = content.split()\n                    line = \"  \"\n                    for word in words:\n                        if len(line) + len(word) &gt; Found transcript: 4db8302a-241b-4c9e-a6a4-a6460917e41b\n\nStep 4: Get Annotation on Transcript Record\n  GET annotations?$filter=_objectid_value eq 4db8302a-241b-4c9e-a6a4-a6460917e41b\n  -&gt; Found annotation with documentbody (base64 encoded)\n\nStep 5: Decode Transcript\n  - Base64 decode documentbody\n  - Parse outer JSON array\n  - Parse inner \"Content\" field as JSON array of messages\n  - Filter out isControlMessage=true entries\n  - Display from.user.displayName + content for each message\n\"\"\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

## 🔍 How I Retrieved the Transcript

```
1. Case → incidents(7811eee8-60fb-f011-8406-7ced8d4279eb)
       ↓
2. Timeline Activities → activitypointers?$filter=_regardingobjectid_value eq {case_id}
       ↓ Found: msdyn_ocliveworkitem (conversation)
3. Transcript Record → msdyn_transcripts where _msdyn_liveworkitemidid_value = {conversation_id}
       ↓ Found: 4db8302a-241b-4c9e-a6a4-a6460917e41b
4. Annotation → annotations?$filter=_objectid_value eq {transcript_id}
       ↓ Contains: documentbody (base64 encoded)
5. Decode → base64 → JSON[0].Content → JSON array of messages
```

The transcript is stored in the **annotations** table (notes) attached to a **msdyn_transcript** record, which links to the conversation via `_msdyn_liveworkitemidid_value`.
